### 1. The operational theorem

There are three distinct guarantees.

**Adaptive validity.** Suppose each completed experiment satisfies the stated forward/reverse work relation. The next protocol, its direction allocation, and its variance-control coefficient may all depend on previously completed observations. The algorithm produces intervals \(C_n\) satisfying

\[
\Pr\!\left\{\theta_*\in C_n
\text{ at every completed observation time }n\right\}
\ge 1-\alpha,
\]

where \(\theta_*=\beta(F_B-F_A)\). This remains true during exploration, incorrect protocol rankings, and data-dependent stopping.

**Constructive termination.** For any two supplied finite rational ferromagnetic Ising models on the same spin set, any rational ratio tolerance \(W>1\), and any error budget \(0<\alpha<1\), the implemented fallback evaluator:

- generates its own exact equilibrium starts;
- acquires complete paired trajectories;
- computes rational bounds on \(Z_A/Z_B\);
- stops with a nonempty interval \([L,U]\) satisfying \(U/L\le W\), or explicitly reports an empty confidence set.

It terminates almost surely with finite expected acquisition cost. On the simultaneous coverage event, the result is nonempty and contains the true ratio. Costs may be exponential; this is not a generic fast partition-function algorithm.

**Learned efficiency.** Within a supplied finite menu of regular paired protocols, under the stated cost-moment assumptions, the learner asymptotically attains the best BAR variance coefficient per unit of measured acquisition cost. This comparison includes optimally weighted combinations of those same BAR experiments.

These guarantees have different assumptions. Arbitrary admissible adaptation preserves coverage. The acquired fallback supplies termination. The finite-library theorem supplies the efficiency conclusion.

## 2. The central operation: removing noise from known experimental randomisation

The physical starting point is Crooks’ relation between forward work and sign-reversed reverse work. It requires the appropriate equilibrium starts and actual microscopic reversal; it is not a generic identity for arbitrary experimental records. :chatgpt-content-reference{index="0"}

Before trial \(i\), choose a forward probability \(p_i\), then draw a fresh direction \(D_i\in\{0,1\}\). Record

\[
X_i=
\begin{cases}
\beta W_F,&D_i=1,\\
-\beta W_R,&D_i=0.
\end{cases}
\]

## 3. Exact certificates at every completed stopping time

For each of the three control streams—\(c=0\), \(c=1\), and the learner—use

\[
\lambda_k=2^{-k-1},
\qquad
w_k=\frac{1}{(k+1)(k+2)},
\]

and the positive products

\[
M_n^{h,\pm,k}(\theta)
=
\prod_{i=1}^{n}
\left(1\pm\lambda_k T_i^h(\theta)\right).
\]

At truth, every product is a martingale. Their fixed weighted mixture therefore controls the probability of ever reaching a rejection threshold.

The executable calculation uses only the finite prefix

\[
k\le \lfloor\log_2(n+1)\rfloor+3.
\]

**Omitted weights are not redistributed.** Newly included components use their full historical products. The growing prefix is bounded by the same fixed infinite mixture at every time, which is sufficient for the guarantee.

A candidate is rejected when either signed mixture reaches \(2/\alpha\). Monotonicity makes inversion one-dimensional. The resulting confidence set may be unbounded or empty; the implementation preserves those possibilities.

This uses established betting and confidence-sequence machinery. The contribution here is the repaired thermodynamic score and the completed acquisition, arithmetic, and cost interfaces around it. :chatgpt-content-reference{index="2"}

### No transcendental oracle in the exact model

Set

\[
a_i=e^{X_i},\qquad z=e^\theta.
\]

Then

\[
q_{\theta,p_i}(X_i)
=
\frac{p_i a_i}{p_i a_i+(1-p_i)z}.
\]

When the work odds \(a_i\), allocations, and controls are rational, all evidence evaluations and endpoint comparisons are rational. Logarithms are needed only to display the final result in free-energy units.

The implementation also accepts rational intervals enclosing the work odds. Outward arithmetic gives conservative evidence bounds. Known conditional score-bias budgets can be paid by dividing each betting factor by \(1+\lambda_k b_i\). Unknown reset or readout error cannot be certified away by this calculation.

One concrete numerical failure was found and repaired: when limiting evidence equals the rejection threshold only at zero or infinity, uncapped bracketing must return an unbounded side. Searching for a finite rejected point would otherwise run forever. Exact regression checks now cover that case.

## 5. Acquiring equilibrium samples and a computable information floor

The model used for the complete construction has weights

\[
w(s)
=
\prod_{\{i,j\}}r_{ij}^{[s_i=s_j]}
\prod_i h_i^{[s_i=+1]},
\qquad
r_{ij}\ge1,\quad h_i>0,
\]

with all parameters rational. Its Hamiltonian is
\(H(s)=-\beta^{-1}\log w(s)\).

The single-site conditional probability is

\[
\Pr(s_i=+1\mid s_{-i})
=
\frac{h_i\prod_{j\sim i}r_{ij}^{s_j}}
     {1+h_i\prod_{j\sim i}r_{ij}^{s_j}}.
\]

It is rational and requires no partition function.

### Exact starts, with replay and randomness counted

The sampler uses monotone coupling from the past. It runs the same stored random maps on the all-minus and all-plus configurations. If they have not coalesced, it extends the past window while preserving every old map and its exposed random bits. Coalescence certifies the equilibrium draw. This mechanism and its Ising application originate with Propp and Wilson. :chatgpt-content-reference{index="3"}

For

\[
\zeta=\max_i\sum_{j\sim i}\frac{r_{ij}-1}{r_{ij}+1}<1,
\]

the proved bound for the implemented two-chain doubling scheme is

\[
\boxed{
\mathbb E K_{\mathrm{reset}}
\le
8\left[
1+\frac{N(\log N+1)}{1-\zeta}
\right],
}
\]

where \(K_{\mathrm{reset}}\) counts actual conditional-probability evaluations.

The proof separately bounds random-bit consumption, map storage, and rational arithmetic. Replayed uniform comparisons cannot simply be charged as fresh independent comparisons; the report supplies the finite-threshold-set argument needed for their bit cost.

Every finite positive model also has an explicit coalescing-word bound. With

\[
p_{i,\min}=\frac{h_i}{h_i+\prod_j r_{ij}},
\qquad
\eta=N^{-N}\prod_i p_{i,\min}>0,
\]

one obtains

\[
\mathbb E K_{\mathrm{reset}}\le \frac{8N}{\eta}.
\]

That bound can be exponentially poor. Eventual exact sampling has not been confused with rapid mixing.

### The actual reverse protocol

A forward stage changes the Hamiltonian and then relaxes. Its reverse must **relax first and then reverse the Hamiltonian change**.

The implemented path probabilities satisfy, exactly,

\[
\frac{P_F(\text{path})}
     {P_R(\text{reversed path})}
=
\frac{a}{z},
\qquad
a=e^{\beta W_F},
\qquad
z=\frac{Z_A}{Z_B}.
\]

Exact enumeration through the execution code verifies this identity. Deliberately reversing the operations in the wrong order fails it.
